name: North Korea
shortSummary: India maintains only minimal diplomatic relations with North Korea, largely constrained by United Nations sanctions and North Korea's close alignment with Pakistan and China on regional issues.
complexity: India adheres strictly to UN Security Council sanctions regimes on North Korea, limiting trade and diplomatic engagement to a bare minimum.

majorChallenges.title: UN sanctions regime
majorChallenges.description: International sanctions sharply limit the scope of any bilateral engagement.

recentDevelopments.title: Relationship remains minimal under sanctions constraints
recentDevelopments.description: India continued to maintain only a bare diplomatic presence, constrained by UN Security Council sanctions on North Korea's weapons programmes.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: No material change — the relationship remains structurally limited by the international sanctions regime.

historicalEvents.title: Establishment of Diplomatic Relations
historicalEvents.description: India and North Korea establish formal diplomatic relations, though engagement has remained minimal.

multilateralRelations.detail: India enforces UN Security Council sanctions on North Korea's weapons programmes.
